keywords: Verification process 2.Problem-solving process 3.Basic skills for validation 4.Data Science 5.PBL for science and technology
educationalGoal: -To gain the basic skills needed in processes from finding problems to solutions. -To understand phenomena, objectives, and events quantitatively and qualitatively. -To be able to find characteristics and laws of phenomena, objectives, and events. -To be able to deliver the above information to a third person intelligibly. -To gain various basic skills to proceed smoothly with verification activities. -To be able to have a picture of technology fields and engineers of discipline.
advice: In this course, to achieve the above educational goals, the students will learn the basic skills required for verification and problem-solving processes. This course will deal with characteristic things of the corresponding department. One is that the students will learn the basic data-handling skills upon data science needed for data collection → organization → analysis→ hypothesis testing → visualization → reporting. One is that the students will learn the basic skills of “PBL for science and technology” including the basic elements of processes from problem-finding to solution and verification activities. For “data-handling skills”, students will learn the following contents. -Measuring the subjective sensation for the media contents quantitatively. -How to use the technical equipment and software, and measure physical quantities related to sensory quantities. -The meaning of statistical data and how to represent the data in a graph. For “PBL for science and technology”, students will lean the following contents. -Deciding a theme from the viewpoint of sensory or physical quantities. -How to design things scientifically.
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of mathematics such as trig functions, logarithms and exponents, Basic skills of information literacy such as report writing and data analysis.

activityGoals.body: To be able to proceed with activities from finding problems to solutions.
To be able to understand phenomena, objects, and events quantitatively and qualitatively, based on data science.
To be able to find characteristics, features, and laws of phenomena, objects, and events.
To be able to deliver acquired information to a third person intelligibly.
To be able to utilize various basic skills needed to proceed smoothly with verification activities.
To be able to have a picture of the technology fields and engineers in the discipline.

achievementLevels.ideal: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events, based upon data science. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of corresponding phenomena, objects, and events. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person intelligibly. 5) To be able to smoothly conduct verification activities independently. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud.
achievementLevels.standard: 1) To be able to proceed with activities from problem-finding to solution with guidance by instructor. 2) To be able to quantitatively and qualitatively recognize phenomena, objects, and events based upon data science, with guidance. 3) To be able to recognize characteristics and regularities of phenomena, objects, and events with guidance. 4) To be able to communicate acquired information to a third person. 5) To be able to conduct verification activities with guidance. 6) To be able to recognize the identity of the major (department) and be proud with guidance.
